answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 67940 Country: India Title: Will ablution (wudhu) be valid if someone has made permanent tattoo on his hand? Question: One of my friends has made permanent tattoo on his hand. So respected Mufti sahab my question is whether he can perform ablution and pray salah in the presence of that permanent tattoo on his hand which can't be removed? Answer ID: 67940 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 759/759/B=10/1437) Since tattoo does not prevent water to reach the skin, rather the skin becomes wet by washing and using water; hence his wudhu and salah both are valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
